purpose: one row per boundary run whose record can never be appended, so a pass that produced no record is legible as a refusal rather than as silence. The queue this file discharges is the runs that were handed to a land lane and could not be taken: ed3c/skill-concerns#158 named the ordering that produced them, and the cure it landed (a persisted producer report) admits only passes that persisted one. None of these did.
no_counts: a row carries no hits, no judge_gaps, no duplicate_blocks and no artifacts_swept, and never will. The numbers are exactly what was lost, and a row that carried them would be the hand-typed record the ledger refuses (ed3c/skill-concerns#130), moved one file over and wearing an apology. scripts/validate_red_team.py reds on a row carrying any measurement key, which is the only way this file stays a refusal instead of becoming the reconstruction path the cure was not allowed to open.
no_station: station is optional and these rows carry none. Which station a lost pass ran at is part of what was lost, and domain/observation-topology.json declares two - guessing between them is the same reconstruction the counts rule refuses, one field over. A row that DOES name a station is graded against that topology like any record.
exit: a row leaves this file only by its run becoming appendable, which for these five it cannot: no bundle survives and no report was persisted. The validator reds on a row whose wave the ledger already carries a record for, so the register cannot double-count a run that did land.

rows.reason: unappendable twice over. The bundle was mutated by the wave's own lands, so ed3c/skill-concerns#131's re-measure procedure has nothing to re-measure; and the record never existed in machine form at all - the report file the duty names carries zero occurrences of run_id, classes_sampled, novel_class_candidates, judge_gaps and duplicate_blocks, and states in its own text that RED-TEAM's JSON block sat in a lane report only. The surviving fragment is a single curve point; per-class hits are gone, and judge_gaps and duplicate_blocks derive from hits.
